answer_1.quote: we propose GRAMMAMT, an incontext learning approach that leverages grammatical information from Interlinear Glossed Text (IGT) to improve machine translation in both low and high-resource settings.
answer_1.outputs: Machine translations from source languages to English and from English to target languages

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report MT evaluation metrics, namely BLEU with SacreBLEU tokenisation, and the chrF++ metric, which exhibits a stronger correlation with human scores. To further strengthen our evaluations, we include a model-based metric using xCOMET-XXL, the latest version of the widely adopted COMET model.
